note: Set A keeps its claims largely tied to values actually present on the sheet (section labels like C3X6, L3X3X1/4, PL5X3/8, the keynote HSS 4 X 4 X 1/4, and the drawn dimensions), though several are vague ('structural element | dimension') and one misbinds the 10" dimension as the depth of a C3X6. Set B adds useful title-block and revision facts and more specific duct-opening clearances, but it introduces clear errors: it converts 1'-4" to 1 ft and 2'-4 1/2" to 2 ft, and cites a quote '1/4" V' for a weld size that does not appear in the text layer. Because B's errors are misread or unsupported values while A's weaknesses are mainly vagueness and one misbinding, A is the more faithful set.
